title: Neural Playground
summary: A feedforward multilayer perceptron written completely from scratch in TypeScript/JavaScript without external ML libraries. Trains live in browser with real-time decision boundary and loss convergence.
outcomes: 60 FPS headless Playwright training with analytical backpropagation
Mini-batch SGD converging to MSE loss 0.042 across 120 epochs
Zero external ML runtime dependencies

title: Seismic Globe
summary: An interactive 3D planetary hypocenter visualizer backed by USGS keyless public earthquake feeds. Features magnitude threshold and temporal window sliders with spherical coordinate projections.
outcomes: 1,200 earthquake events rendered at 60 FPS in headless Playwright
Build-time Python ETL serializes GeoJSON into static JSON (<180 KB)
Fully vendored local Three.js build with zero runtime fetch requests

title: Digit Atlas
summary: A high-dimensional manifold explorer projecting 1,797 handwritten digits (8x8 bitmaps) into a 2D t-SNE map with client-side linear classifier inference pad.
outcomes: Measured 96.94% test accuracy on 20% holdout split
Client-side matrix-vector inference latency under 1ms
Zero runtime Python or ML package dependencies

title: Material Lab
summary: A real-time physical optics and shader studio featuring 3 procedural geometries generated via headless Blender scripts. Tune physical transmission, IOR, roughness, and metalness live.
outcomes: 3 watertight .glb models generated via headless Blender 5.4.0 (12,288 faces, 0 gltf-validator errors)
60 FPS real-time physical transmission and refraction
Vendored local Three.js modules with zero CDN dependencies

title: Aether Spatial Optics
summary: A fictional brand identity and spatial design system for a refractive hardware and optics laboratory. Includes SVG mark, type pairing, 3 applied mockups, and live Brand Shift palette switcher.
outcomes: 3 swappable chromatic palettes verified for WCAG AAA contrast ratio ≥ 8.2:1
Responsive CSS/SVG mockups with 0 console errors
Explicitly labeled 'Concept, not a real client'

title: Glass UI Lab
summary: An interactive showcase of 6 spatial UI components engineered with CSS 3D perspectives and spring physics: parallax card stack, magnetic dock, inertia sheet, tilt card, switches, and command palette.
outcomes: Damped harmonic oscillator physics running at 60 FPS
Verified WCAG AAA contrast ratio ≥ 7:1
Full prefers-reduced-motion and keyboard navigation compatibility

title: Motion Studies
summary: Three kinetic studies engineered in code: harmonic wave typography, particle-text morphing, and 3D origami prism topological unfolding. Features loopable 8.6s MP4 artifact.
outcomes: 1,200 particle vectors animated at 60 FPS in headless Playwright
Loopable 8.6s MP4 captured via automated ffmpeg pipeline (836 KB)
Zero Playwright console errors
